title: Revit Workflow and Instruction Source Resolution Map
resolution_rule: A workflow or instruction named in the catalogue is not treated as an existing standalone source asset unless a concrete source page or machine-readable artifact was found. Catalogue-only entries remain source-planned capability slots.

workflows.name: Project Model Setup Workflow
workflows.notes: Project-template, worksharing, and S6 sources contain implementation guidance, but no standalone pages matching the six instruction IDs were identified in the targeted search.

workflows.name: Workset Management Workflow
workflows.notes: Worksharing source and inventory captures support the topic. No concrete standalone instruction pages for the four catalogue IDs were identified. A governed Workset Registry is referenced conceptually but no concrete registry artifact was identified in this pass.

workflows.name: Link Creation and Link Update/Maintenance
workflows.notes: The Revit Link inventory explicitly reports that no standalone pages titled for Revit Link were identified. S6 and Worksharing are the substantive source authorities.

workflows.name: Sheet Setup Workflow
workflows.notes: The dedicated Titleblock Instruction Set is a concrete executable child asset and covers substantial parts of titleblock assignment, metadata, sheet identity, revisions, and QA. No standalone Sheet Registry was identified.

workflows.name: Model Health and QA/QC Validation
workflows.notes: The Appendix E QA checklist and S3.7 QA/QC source provide substantive guidance, but the targeted instruction IDs were not found as standalone instruction assets. QA/QC Checklist Registry and Model Health Report are catalogue-future concepts.

workflows.name: IFC / Exchange Export Workflow
workflows.notes: Documentation & Export Style is draft. Navisworks Export Settings JSON is a concrete machine-readable instruction set for coordination exports, but an Export Preset Registry remains explicitly future. No concrete generic W8.1 export-preset registry was identified.

other_concrete_assets.title: Revit Instructions Definitions Workflows Consolidated
other_concrete_assets.notes: This is an agent/page-authoring specification for consolidating L6 Revit content, not the consolidated instruction corpus itself. It explicitly forbids inventing new guidance or rewriting L4/L5 governance.
